title: On-Device Interaction Mining
scope_decision: retain candidate: Android Accessibility/touch event streams are collected, joined with screenshot and view hierarchy snapshots, reconstructed into interaction traces, and quality-audited; this is UI-interaction-trace processing, not a screen-time or unlock-session method
future_completion_boundary: The paper defines a useful source-located collector/repair/redaction/trace method and reports two evaluations. Exact study replay remains blocked by the unpinned evaluated APK/code revision, unreleased complete trace corpus and researcher ground-truth logs, and underspecified timing, pairing, boundary, and redaction details. Later public source is linked implementation context, not an automatic study oracle.

source_method_variants.relation: capture, conditional manual repair, removal of captured sensitive information before research use or sharing, and manual enrichment; device and web affordances described but not a source-declared multiverse
100-app raw capture accuracy measured before researchers repaired 682 interactions; cannot use repaired accuracy as raw-capture accuracy
five participants, 15 traces, recording and human post-processing; distinct cohort and denominator from capture evaluation

event_model.joined_unit: ODIM event is a time-linked screenshot plus JSON view hierarchy and possibly a gesture; a touch first creates an incomplete event, and a subsequent selected AccessibilityEvent supplies type/element-derived coordinates to complete it
event_model.source_version_boundary: Paper §4.2 says trace starts with new app launch and ends on return to home screen, organized by app and timestamp; later README describes package transitions and launcher/system-UI exclusions. These are not silently equated.

reported_result_oracles_not_settings.qualification: Within manually selected evaluation traces; not a universal capture guarantee or post-repair rate. Table 1 rounds totals to 61/16/23.
Observed result distributions, not classification thresholds.
Repair happens after raw capture scoring; no separate post-repair numeric accuracy oracle disclosed.
Separate exploratory analysis using participant actions as reference; not a production preprocessing choice.

indispensable_unavailable_facts: Exact evaluated APK/server commit, build configuration, Android OS versions and repo-to-study revision binding are absent; later HEAD cannot fill historical behavior.
Full raw interaction traces, image bytes, hierarchy JSON, ground-truth screen/gesture observations, and participant edits for the two evaluations were not found as an exact archived study bundle.

Exact AccessibilityEvent enum allowlist, service filters, overlay touch action phases, screenshot and hierarchy thread synchronization, capture latency pairing, most-recent overwrite/race policy, and absent AccessibilityEvent timeout are not fully disclosed.
The gesture mapping from AccessibilityEvent type to tap/long tap/scroll, element-center coordinate system and scroll dx/dy units/sign are not fully specified by the article.

App launch/home-return predicates, package transition semantics, handling of intermediate apps/system UI, timestamp field/precision/timezone, equal-time ordering, and trace closure on shutdown/background/permission loss are unreported in the paper.
Manual edit history, deleted-screen provenance, split boundaries, repaired-gesture original values, and adjudicator identity are not disclosed as a frozen output schema.
On-device screenshot removal/masking details, hierarchy redaction tag, keyword matching, web IoU cutoff and intersection convention, and release moderation criteria are not fixed by the article.
The complete evaluation sampling list, researcher observation log, NASA-TLX item subset, and raw participant scores are unavailable for exact numerical reproduction.

reusable.use: can carry source settings and locators, with unresolved exact execution status; no ODIM candidate profile yet
captures AccessibilityService, overlay, screenshot/hierarchy acquisition provenance and unknown timing, not UI event payload itself
can express capture→join→trace→manual repair→redact→enrich→release dependency graph prospectively; no instantiated operations or import proof
can preserve ordering uncertainty and distinction between local raw/edited and moderated public trace

not_semantically_equivalent.reason: It is typed for Android UsageStats rows; it has no screenshot, AccessibilityNodeInfo hierarchy, overlay touch, gesture, or repair lineage.
An ODIM UI trace is a sequential set of multimodal interaction events with user-editable boundaries, not an app-foreground duration interval.
These UsageStats notification codes do not represent ODIM Accessibility gestures.

candidate_semantic_residues.residue: Current data ontology lacks a typed trace event linking distinct touch occurrence, AccessibilityEvent, screenshot, hierarchy, and optional gesture with captured/completed status and time-specific provenance.

required_execution_proofs: First, version-bind the evaluated Android/web implementation or label any run as later-code compatibility, never exact study execution.
Use order- and timing-adversarial fixtures where touch, screenshot, hierarchy, and multiple AccessibilityEvents disagree; preserve original versus effective gesture and incomplete status.

Round-trip a trace with app launch/home close, missing gesture, misclassification, manually deleted screen, manual split, and separately masked screenshot/hierarchy metadata through import, persistence, GUI edit, and export.

Keep 100-app raw-capture results, five-participant usability actions, and GPT-4.1 mini baseline as distinct validation oracles with their own denominators; do not infer a post-repair capture percentage.
canonical_projection_policy: Isolated draft only. Do not merge or mark executable. Preserve 2025 article wording separately from later repository HEAD and preserve evaluation baselines as analysis, not as deployed collector settings.
